name: Mohács (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, white, red and white, charged at the centre of the red with the town arms of Mohács (a blue shield with a red-clad figure, with a helm and red and white mantling).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Mohács arms with helm and mantling
